// EngineData: CAN ID 0x100 (standard), 8 bytes, sender ECM, cycle time 10 ms
// Engine status broadcast, 10 ms cycle.
//
// Decode pseudo-code generated by CanViewer from demo.dbc.
// data[0] .. data[7] are the payload bytes; bit 0 is the least significant bit of a byte.
// Shifts and masks work on unsigned integers wide enough for the signal.

// EngineSpeed: start bit 0, 16 bits, Intel, unsigned, factor 0.25, offset 0, range 0 .. 16383.75 rpm
EngineSpeed_raw = data[0] | (data[1] << 8)
EngineSpeed = EngineSpeed_raw * 0.25

// EngineTemp: start bit 16, 8 bits, Intel, unsigned, factor 1, offset -40, range -40 .. 215 degC
EngineTemp_raw = data[2]
EngineTemp = EngineTemp_raw - 40

// ThrottlePosition: start bit 24, 8 bits, Intel, unsigned, factor 0.4, offset 0, range 0 .. 100 %
ThrottlePosition_raw = data[3]
ThrottlePosition = ThrottlePosition_raw * 0.4

// EngineTorque: start bit 32, 12 bits, Intel, unsigned, factor 0.5, offset 0, range 0 .. 2047.5 Nm
EngineTorque_raw = data[4] | ((data[5] & 0x0F) << 8)
EngineTorque = EngineTorque_raw * 0.5

// TorqueRequest: start bit 44, 12 bits, Intel, signed, factor 0.5, offset 0, range -1024 .. 1023.5 Nm
TorqueRequest_raw = (data[5] >> 4) | (data[6] << 4)
if TorqueRequest_raw >= 2048: TorqueRequest_raw = TorqueRequest_raw - 4096
TorqueRequest = TorqueRequest_raw * 0.5

// EngineRunning: start bit 56, 1 bit, Intel, unsigned, factor 1, offset 0, range 0 .. 1
// values: 0 = "Stopped", 1 = "Running"
EngineRunning_raw = data[7] & 0x01
EngineRunning = EngineRunning_raw
